placeholder.name: Placeholder
placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed when no items are selected.

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.description: Whether the multi-select input is disabled.

disallowCreation.name: Disallow Creation
disallowCreation.description: When true, prevents users from creating new options by pressing Enter.

isLoading.name: Is Loading
isLoading.description: When true, displays a loading skeleton in the dropdown.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: The visual theme of the multi-select container.

label.name: Label
label.description: Label text displayed above the input.

error.name: Error
error.description: Error message displayed below the input.

warning.name: Warning
warning.description: Warning message displayed below the input.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Helper text displayed below the input.

optional.name: Optional
optional.description: When true, marks the field as optional in the label.

orientation.name: Orientation
orientation.description: The layout orientation of the label and input.
